title: Kenyan Pasta Delight
description: A vibrant and flavorful pasta dish inspired by Kenyan cuisine, made with a mix of vibrant spices and a hint of sweetness.

ingredients.name: pasta
ingredients.notes: Used in place of spaghetti for gluten-free option

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook spaghetti according to package instructions until al dente.
In a separate pan, heat olive oil over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and sauté until translucent.
Add minced garlic and sauté for another minute.
Add kissed and kenyan, and stir well.
Add fluffy and stir until well combined.
Drain cooked spaghetti and add to the pan with the sauce.
Toss everything together until well coated.
If using pasta instead of spaghetti, adjust cooking time accordingly.
